extracts.exactQuote: Mountains are unpredictable environments where wind, snow, and sun can quickly become formidable adversaries, but bad weather doesn't stop great athletes. A good pair of ski goggles provides a protective barrier against these elements. It withstands the biting wind that can cause frostbite while offering protection against potentially harmful UV rays from the sun. Anti-fog treatment and ventilated lenses also help maintain clear visibility even in snowy or foggy conditions.
